name: No Regrets makes March of the Black King raise Armor by 15% (#2230)
contract: No Regrets 681093 (installed Spell.dbc) is a passive family-21 spell with two SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) effects on SpellClassMask[2] 0x4: effect 0 op 11 (COOLDOWN) base -1 die 1 = 0 (a no-op) and effect 1 op 12 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT2) base 14 die 1 -> +15. Every March of the Black King rank 681095, 681212-681217 carries family flag [2] 0x4; effect index 1 of rank 7 681217 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE_PCT (101, misc 1 = physical) with base -1 die 1 = 0, so the modifier lifts a zero to 15. The tooltip reads 'Your March of the Black King now increases your Armor by 15%.' A control and a holder cast the same rank; the holder's aura effect 1 must read 15 (0 for the control) and its armor, computed with identical race, class, level and no gear, must be 1.15 times the control's (band 1.14-1.16 absorbs the int32 truncation of an armor value near 200).

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Learn March of the Black King rank 7
Learn March of the Black King rank 7
Control casts March of the Black King
No Regrets holder casts March of the Black King
Without the talent March's armor effect is 0%
With No Regrets March's armor effect is 15%
Control armor while March is active
Holder armor is 15% higher than the control's
